question: Do late deliveries have a meaningful relationship with customer satisfaction? Quantify the relationship using the data.
metric_definition: Observation unit: one order. Average multiple review rows per order first. Include only orders with actual and estimated delivery timestamps. Late means actual delivery is after estimated delivery.

question: Which product categories have the lowest average customer review scores? Only consider categories with at least 100 reviewed orders.
metric_definition: Observation unit: one distinct order-category pair. Multiple items from the same category in one order count once. Average multiple review rows per order first.

question: Which sellers have the highest late-delivery rates? Only consider sellers with at least 100 delivered orders.
metric_definition: Observation unit: one distinct seller-order pair. Multiple items from the same seller in one order count once. Only include orders with actual and estimated delivery timestamps.

question: Did delivery performance improve or deteriorate over time? Analyze the monthly late-delivery rate.
metric_definition: Observation unit: one order grouped by purchase month. Only include orders with purchase, actual delivery, and estimated delivery timestamps. Only include months with at least 100 delivered orders.

question: Is customer satisfaction meaningfully different across payment types? Quantify the differences.
metric_definition: Observation unit: one order. Average multiple review rows per order first. Assign one primary payment type using the payment row with largest payment_value, breaking ties by lower payment_sequential then payment_type.
